# aws-iam-policy-splitter_example (Data Source)

Takes a list of iam policy documents and splits them into multiple policies if they exceed the AWS size limits. Uses a binpacking algorithm to split the policies as efficiently as possible. Attempts to split policies in a way that keeps like policies together
